diff --git a/jira-milestones/devel-release/new-cycle-opening.yaml b/jira-milestones/devel-release/new-cycle-opening.yaml
index da93893..2a19289 100644
--- a/jira-milestones/devel-release/new-cycle-opening.yaml
+++ b/jira-milestones/devel-release/new-cycle-opening.yaml
@@ -166,8 +166,8 @@ timelines:
       Note: image owners are listed in the product manifests available from the ISO Tracker (https://iso.qa.ubuntu.com/).
 
       This includes:
-      - 'Get the list of seeded snaps from the seeds: `readarray -t seeded_snaps < <(grep -ohP "(?<=snap:)[^\s/]*" * 2>/dev/null | sort -u)`'
-      - 'Try downloading all the snaps from the stable channel: for `s in "${seeded_snaps[@]}"; do snap download "$s" --channel=stable/ubuntu-XX.YY; done`'
+      - Check which snaps don't have the correct new seed by running (for example):
+      - `ubuntu-release-tools/scripts-for-cards/seeded-snaps-new-release.py --from-release "25.10" --to-release "26.04" --manifest-url $MANIFEST_URL`
       - If a failing download is for an internally developed snap (we're upstream), contact the relevant team to have the channel open.
       - If a failing download is for an external snap (e.g. firefox), ask the image owner to ask the snap upstream to open the channel.
       - Iterate until all the downloads succeed.
